Cloudways Velocity is Cloudways' managed Node.js hosting.

If you want more than Node hosting, your app plus managed databases, object storage, static sites, and a load balancer in a single dashboard across seven clouds, Kloudbean is the alternative worth a look. You get an always-on Node runtime with PM2, deploys from GitHub, managed PostgreSQL/MySQL/MongoDB/Redis next to the app, flat pricing from $8/mo, and free migration. Cloudways brings a mature brand and round-the-clock support, so weigh both.

Read the full guide: https://www.kloudbean.com/blog/cloudways-velocity-alternative/
